summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) announcing major holdings notifications under Greek Law 3556/2007 following admission of 12,000,000 new common shares to parallel trading on Euronext Athens on 11 September 2026. Passively, Chalkoessa Maritime Inc.'s stake fell to 4.74% from 5.30% on non-participation, and Mr. Polys Hajioannou's indirect holding via controlled entities slipped to 43.82% (49,881,427 shares) despite Moutoulas acquiring 1,500,000 new shares. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation transaction is present; this is a routine ownership-threshold disclosure. Watch for further creep or stake shifts.
